headline: Bitcoin Slips Below $82,000 as DeFi Tokens Lead Cryptocurrency Declines
summary: Bitcoin dropped as much as 2.9% to around $81,600 alongside weakness in Nasdaq futures, while decentralized finance tokens fell 6% and the broader CoinDesk 80 index declined 3.5%.
why: Cryptocurrencies frequently correlate with tech equity sentiment and high-beta risk appetite in macro markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Renewed skepticism around tech capital expenditures and falling Nasdaq futures weighed on digital asset prices.

why_moved: Bitcoin fell below $82,000 as tech-heavy equity futures declined and investors pared exposure to speculative assets.
